conclusion: The arbitrary DOS buffer requires page-aware access; current lease ownership is F session state, not an independent B native API capability. Resolve this dependency with the S13 guest-memory boundary, preserving original DEM I/O and error policy. The setter alone is pure numeric construction, but moving it alone would leave acquisition/release and its lease ABI coupled to F.
